Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Gourmet Kitchen Delights is a full-service restaurant specializing in gourmet cuisine, offering a diverse menu that includes seasonal dishes and locally sourced ingredients. Our operations involve in-house dining, takeout services, and limited outdoor seating during warmer months. We pride ourselves on providing a high-quality dining experience while maintaining strict food safety protocols. We occasionally host events and cater private parties, which enhance our community engagement. Currently, we do not rely heavily on third-party food delivery platforms, focusing instead on direct customer service to ensure quality and safety in food handling.

Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On 03/15/2023, the restaurant experienced a fire in the kitchen due to a malfunctioning fryer, resulting in property damage estimated at $10,000. The claim was reported immediately and is currently in the process of being settled. Additionally, on 07/20/2023, there was a slip and fall incident involving a customer, leading to a claimed loss of $5,000. This claim is still open, pending further investigation into liability.
